title: Recursive CTE
description: Using a recursive CTE, generate the organizational hierarchy starting from the CEO (manager_id IS NULL). Show employee name, level (depth), and the path from CEO to employee.
hints: Anchor: SELECT employee_id, name, 0 AS level, name::TEXT AS path WHERE manager_id IS NULL
Recursive: JOIN employees ON manager_id = anchor.employee_id, increment level
Append to path with path || ' -> ' || e.name
Use UNION ALL between anchor and recursive members
